snippet.title: Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy DLC2 Gameplay
snippet.description:
DLC2 Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3858250/DLC2

We're currently working hard on the development of DLC2 for Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy. Once the content is complete, we'll announce the official release date!
For now, check out the gameplay of a brand new boss battle!
